one_liner_zh: CrowdStrike EPS小幅超預期，雲端資安平台訂閱動能維持穩健。
one_liner_en: CrowdStrike modestly beat EPS, sustaining steady cloud-security subscription momentum.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期：EPS 1.12略高於預期1.10（+1.56%），表現穩定。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：1.56%小幅超標屬穩健執行，反映Falcon平台訂閱經濟持續累積。短期成長型資金仍偏好，但缺乏營收年增與本益比資料使成長與估值判讀保守。中期關鍵在新增ARR動能與多模組滲透。追蹤指標：年化經常性收入與淨新增ARR、淨收入留存率、訂閱毛利、自由現金流利潤率，以及管理層對全年ARR與獲利的指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is neutral-to-positive: a modest 1.56% beat reflects steady execution and compounding Falcon subscription economics. Near-term, growth capital still favors the name, while the missing revenue YoY and P/E keep the growth and valuation read conservative. Mid-term, net-new ARR momentum and multi-module penetration are key. Track: ARR and net-new ARR, net revenue retention, subscription gross margin, free-cash-flow margin, and management guidance on full-year ARR and earnings.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.12美元，略高於預期1.10美元，正向驚喜1.56%
營收13.1億美元，平台規模持續成長
Falcon模組化平台帶動高黏著訂閱收入
經常性收入與留存率提供盈餘能見度
highlights_en: EPS of $1.12 came in slightly above the $1.10 estimate, a 1.56% positive surprise
Revenue of $1.31B reflects continued platform scaling
The modular Falcon platform drives sticky subscription revenue
Recurring revenue and retention provide earnings visibility
risks_zh: 營收年增資料缺失，成長斜率須由其他季度佐證
SaaS高估值使股價對指引敏感
競爭與新增ARR增速放緩風險
risks_en: Missing revenue YoY means the growth slope needs corroboration from other quarters
Rich SaaS valuation makes the stock sensitive to guidance
Competition and risk of slowing net-new ARR growth
